operations.description: Estimate the cost of taking a Lyft between two points.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] cost [PATH] cost [PARAMS] end lat lng ride start type [SCHEMA] cost enum estimate ride type

operations.description: The drivers endpoint returns a list of nearby drivers' lat and lng at a given location.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] drivers [PATH] drivers [PARAMS] lat lng [SCHEMA] by driver drivers nearby ride type

operations.description: The ETA endpoint lets you know how quickly a Lyft driver can come get you
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] eta [PATH] eta [PARAMS] destination lat lng ride type [SCHEMA] enum eta ride type

operations.description: The v1 of this endpoint returns the user's ID, v2 will return more general info about the user. We require authentication for this endpoint, so we extract the user ID from the access token.
Get a list of past & current rides for this passenger.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] rides [PATH] rides [PARAMS] end limit start time [SCHEMA] cancellation cost current detail driver dropoff enum item line location other passenger pickup profile ride status type vehicle with

operations.description: Get the status of a ride along with information about the driver, vehicle and price of a given ride ID
operations.summary: Get the ride detail of a given ride ID
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] ride [PATH] rides [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] cancellation cost current detail driver dropoff enum item line location other passenger pickup profile ride status type user vehicle with

operations.description: Get the receipt information of a processed ride by providing the ride id. Receipts will only be available to view once the payment has been processed. In the case of canceled ride, cancellation penalty is included if applicable.
operations.summary: Get the receipt of the rides.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] ride receipt [PATH] rides receipt [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] charge cost enum item line profile receipt ride

operations.description: The ride types endpoint returns information about what kinds of Lyft rides you can request at a given location.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] ride types [PATH] ridetypes [PARAMS] lat lng ride type [SCHEMA] details enum pricing ride type

operations.description: Request a Lyft come pick you up at the given location.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] new ride [PATH] rides [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] detail enum error location passenger request ride status type user

operations.description: Cancel a ongoing ride which was requested earlier by providing the ride id.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] cancel ride [PATH] rides cancel [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] cancellation cost error request

operations.description: Add or update the ride's destination. Note that the ride must still be active (not droppedOff or canceled), and that destinations on Lyft Line rides can not be changed.
operations.summary: Update the destination of the ride
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] set ride destination [PATH] rides destination [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] lat lng location

operations.description: Add the passenger's 1 to 5 star rating of the ride, optional written feedback, and optional tip amount in minor units and currency. The ride must already be dropped off, and ratings must be given within 24 hours of drop off. For purposes of display, 5 is considered the default rating. When this endpoint is successfully called, payment processing will begin.
operations.summary: Add the passenger's rating, feedback, and tip
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] set ride rating [PATH] rides rating [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] params rating request tip

operations.description: Preset a Prime Time percentage in the region surrounding the specified location. This Prime Time percentage will be applied when requesting cost, or when requesting a ride in sandbox mode.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] set prime time [PATH] sandbox primetime [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] primetime sandbox

operations.description: Propagate a sandbox-ride through various ride status
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] set ride status [PATH] sandbox rides [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] enum ride sandbox status update

operations.description: The sandbox-ridetypes endpoint allows you to preset the ridetypes in the region surrounding the specified latitude and longitude to allow testing different scenarios
operations.summary: Preset types of rides for sandbox
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] set ride types [PATH] sandbox ridetypes [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] enum ride sandbox type

operations.description: Set driver availability for the provided ride_type in the city/region surrounding the specified location
operations.summary: Driver availability for processing ride request
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] set ride type availability [PATH] sandbox ridetypes [PARAMS] ride type [SCHEMA] availability driver sandbox
